title: AgentCE catalog registry
description: One entry per published, signed AgentCE base catalog (technical validation machinery; not yet a public, served artifact -- see docs/adr/0020-catalog-registry.md).

id.description: The catalog id (matches catalog.yaml's own id, and its source directory name).

digest.description: signing.digest_tree over the catalog directory, excluding the detached signature file.

source_path.description: Repository-relative path to the catalog directory.

signature_file.description: The detached-signature filename inside the catalog directory.

trust_root.description: Which trust root the signature verifies against.

keyid.description: The content-addressed id of the signing key, as recorded in the trust root.
